status.description: Latest probe result; `unavailable` while Solana data is not configured

description: Whether Solana data is currently being served: latest probe status and finalized slot. When to use: Before relying on the Solana verdict endpoints, or to explain a 503 from them. Prefer another tool: Not a measure of the Solana network itself, only of this service's access to it; use the latest-slot endpoint to see chain progress. Example: solana_network_health {} Paid: 0.01452 USDC or 0.0121 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.0005 EUR-denominated units (approx 2000 calls per bundle) or 0.0006 USD-denominated units (approx 1366 calls per bundle).
